paite: Huan ka kiang ah TOUPA thu ahong tung a: ka kianh ah,
heading: TOUPA Namsau

paite: "Mihing tapa, Jerusalem maituah inla, amun siangthou lam nga in na thu gen inla, Israel gam tung ah thu gen in;
Israel gam kiang ah, huchi in TOUPA'N achi hi: Ngai in, ka hon dou ahi, ka namsau apai a kipan ka phawi ding a, na lak ua midiktat leh diktat lou kibang sap in ka phuk ding.
Huchi in na lak ua midiktat leh diktat lou ka phuk ding ziak in ka namsau apai a kipan apawt ding a, simlam a kipan mallam pha in mihing tengteng aphuk ding hi.
Huchi in mi tengteng in, kei TOUPA'N ka namsau apai a kipan ka phawi ahi chih athei ding uh, akikhum ngei nawnta kei ding hi."
Huaiziak in nang mihing tapa, thum huthut inla khasetak in amitmuh un thum in.

Huan "Bangziak a thum na hia?" ahon chih uleh, "Thuthang ziak in ahi, ahong tung sin ngal a, huai hun in lungtang chiteng azul ding a, khut tengteng azaw ding a, lungsim teng abah ding a, khuk tengteng tui bang in azaw ding a; ngai in, ahong tung hi, atangtun ding, chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi, chi in," achi hi.
Huan ka kiang ah TOUPA thu ahong tung a: ka kiang ah,
Mihing tapa, thu gen inla, huchi in TOUPA'N achi hi:
"Namsau, namsau tat-hiam ahita, tetsak ahita, mi satna ding a tat-hiam ahita, tetsak ahi, khophia bang in! I nuamsa lailai ding maw? ka tapa, chiang na simmoh, sing a bawl peuhmah toh,
tetsak ahi, khut a let ding in ahi namsau tat-hiam tetsak ahi, thatmi khut a tuang ding in.
Mihing tapa, kikou inla; sehal ham in, ka mite tung ahi ngal a; Israel miliante teng tung mahmah; piak ahi ua, ka mite toh, namsau nuai ah; huaiziak in kikou inla, na pheipi beng in.
Hiai namsau midang tung a chiamtehsa ahi ngal a, na ngaihsak kei hitaleh bang suak ding chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi hi."
"Huaiziak in nang, mihing tapa, khut beng hial in thu gen in; thah a om dingte a ding namsau nihvei liksuk in om hen, ahi, thumvei; tampi thahna ding namsau ahi.
Lungtang zul, apukna uh apunna ding in, namsaute kongbiang teng ah ka giaksak hi; Ah! Khophia bang in ate zolzol, sihna namsau.
Nakpi'n gamtang in, taklam ah, gamtang in veilam ah leng van zel inla, na mazawn peuhmah ah leng.
Ke'n leng khut ka beng ding a, ka tangtun ngei ding, ka hehna, kei TOUPA'N hiai ka genta hi, chi in,” achi hi.
TOUPA thu ka kiang ah ahong tung a, ka kiang ah,
heading: Babulon Kumpipa Namsau

paite: "Mihing tapa, Babulon kumpipa namsau hong tuntheihna ding in lampi nih na bawl in; huai lampi nihte gam khat a kipan in ahong pawtkhe ding uh ahi; lampi kawkmuhna bawl inla, kho pilut na khomual ah bawl in.
Ammon mite khua Rabbah a namsau ahong tuntheihna ding in lampi sep inla, Judah gam lai Jerusalem kulh ah leng.
Ai san ding in Babulon kumpipa lampi ka ah adingh a, lampi nih kigawmna tak ah; thalte asing loklok a terephim adong a, sa sin a-en hi.
A-aisanna ah akhut taklam ah Jerusalem ana tuang a, kulh suksiatnate galsual awng zuazuate, kongpi zawn a kulh suksiatnate, mual pawngsunte, kulh bawlte toh.
Aisan vuaksuak lel bang ahi a, himahleh mat a a-omna ding ua athulimlouhna uh theihkhiakna lel ding ahi."

Huaiziak in Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: Theihgigena ding a na thulimlouhna uh na bawl ziak un na tatleknate uh ahong kilang, na thilhih tengteng uah na khelhnate uh akimu kilkel a, theihkhiak na hong hih tak ziak un khut a mat na hong hi ding uhi.
Huan nang, Israel heutu, migilou si ding a liampa, na gitlouhna gawtna tawp ni ahong tung e;
Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: "Heutu lukhu paihsak unla, lallukhu suhsak un, hiai angei in a-om kei ding; mivuallelte tawisang unla, miliante vuallelsak un.
Ka lumlet ding, ka lumlet ding, ka lumlet ding; hiai leng angei in a-om kei ding, aneimi diktak ahong pai mateng amah ka pe ding hi."

Huan nang mihing tapa, thu gen inla, hichi in chi in; Toupa PATHIAN in Ammon tate tungtang ah leh agensiatna thu uah hichi in achi: "Namsau, namsau phawi ahita, mithahna ding leh hihmanna ding khophia bang a tetsak ahita.
heading: Namsau Leh Ammonte

paite: "Kilakna taklou nang ahon musak ua, zuau in ai ahon sansak ua, namsau bel migilou si ding a liam, agitlouhna ni uh tawp hong tung dingte ngawng ah na golh ding, ahon chih un azuau uh ahi.
Apai ah thun in. Na pianna siam a na omna gam ngei ah na thu ka ngaihtuah ding.
Na tung ah ka hehna ka sung dia, ka thangpaihna mei na tung ah ka toh ding, minunsetak, hihman siamtak khut ah ka hon mansak ding.
Mei a khul ding na hi ding a, gam lai ah na sisan abo ding a, theih mahmah na hita kei ding, kei TOUPA'N ka genta ngal a, chi in," achi hi.
